whatIsAstrology.title: Why Do You Need Astrology?
whatIsAstrology.paragraph1: Vedic astrology studies how the positions of planets and stars at the moment of your birth shape your personality, relationships, and life path. It is one of the oldest systematic traditions for understanding these patterns.
whatIsAstrology.paragraph2: This classical knowledge connects everyday questions to a larger framework. By studying your birth chart, you can better understand your strengths, challenges, and the timing of important life events.

howConsultationsWork.title: How Does Kundali Generation Work?
howConsultationsWork.paragraph1: Enter your full name, date, time, and place of birth. We resolve your birth location to precise coordinates and timezone, then compute your chart using classical Vedic calculation methods with the Lahiri Ayanamsha.
howConsultationsWork.paragraph2: Your report includes planetary positions, divisional charts, Vimshottari Dasha periods, Yogas, Doshas, and Ashtakavarga - all generated from real astronomical data, not generic templates.
